|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E2 of [[Let the Wookiee Win (V) (Virtual Block 6)]] (version 3 of 4). The image here is the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB6-L-letthewookieewin-pre.gif]]). The current text is [[Let the Wookiee Win (V) (Virtual Block 6) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3). Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source; differences that come only from a document's medium (icons written out in words on the card list, straight quotes, credit lines) are not changes.
* '''Original''' ([[Let the Wookiee Win (V) (Virtual Block 6)]]): text as given in the first copy of the Virtual Block 6.1 (Reflections IV) release sheet (official text as of 4 September 2009)<ref name="sheet-6_1-first">Virtual Set 6: Reflections IV sheet, first copy ("Official text as of September 4, 2009"; attachment Block6WithRebelFleetV.pdf, [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1375528 Players Committee forum])</ref>: “USED: Reveal the top 3 cards of Reserve Deck; place one in hand, and the others on bottom of Used Pile (in any order). STARTING: If your starting location was a non-[Special Edition] location, ▼ an [Immune to Alter] Effect and any number of <> sites with < 3 total [Light Side Force]. Place this Interrupt in hand.” The release-sheet slip prints the slip number “98” at bottom right.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Let the Wookiee Win (V) (Virtual Block 6) (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) showed “deploy from Reserve Deck an always [Immune to Alter] Effect and two <> sites” instead of “▼ an [Immune to Alter] Effect and any number of <> sites”<ref name="cl-1261_97-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref>: “USED: Reveal the top 3 cards of Reserve Deck; place one in hand, and the others on bottom of Used Pile (in any order). STARTING: If your starting location was a non-[Special Edition] location, deploy from Reserve Deck an always [Immune to Alter] Effect and two <> sites with < 3 total [Light Side Force]. Place this Interrupt in hand.” The card list is a text page: no slip, picture or slip number, and icons are written out in words.
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB6-L-letthewookieewin-pre.gif]]) prints the original printed text again, word for word: “USED: Reveal the top 3 cards of Reserve Deck; place one in hand, and the others on bottom of Used Pile (in any order). STARTING: If your starting location was a non-[Special Edition] location, ▼ an [Immune to Alter] Effect and any number of <> sites with < 3 total [Light Side Force]. Place this Interrupt in hand.” '''What changed:''' “▼ an [Immune to Alter] Effect and any number of <> sites” again, for the card list's “deploy from Reserve Deck an always [Immune to Alter] Effect and two <> sites”. The image is undated. The PC's image folder (Virtual6-Light) lists the file, with every other file in it, as last modified on 25 February 2013<ref name="r6-Virtual6-Light">[https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034714/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual6-Light/large/?C=M;O=A Apache directory listing of Virtual6-Light/large] (Internet Archive, captured 18 August 2019): every file in the folder last modified 25 February 2013; the captures of the image in 2018 and 2019 have the same bytes as the file on the wiki. Research note R6, 11 November 2026.</ref>; it is dated by that upload date, after the card list and before the Master List. The date is a bulk upload of the whole folder, so the image may have been made earlier, but the wiki orders versions by the date each document was published (Bill, 11 November 2026). It is a version of its own even though its words repeat an earlier text (Bill, 11 November 2026: every publication is a version). The card image is the whole card, with the Decipher picture, and prints the slip number “98” at bottom right.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Let the Wookiee Win (V) (Virtual Block 6) (Errata 3)]]): The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Light Side, p. 34)<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=34, page 34. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=34 Internet Archive]</ref> prints the original printed text again, word for word: “USED: Reveal the top 3 cards of Reserve Deck; place one in hand, and the others on bottom of Used Pile (in any order). STARTING: If your starting location was a non-[Special Edition] location, ▼ an [Immune to Alter] Effect and any number of <> sites with < 3 total [Light Side Force]. Place this Interrupt in hand.” '''What changed:''' Nothing in the words: the Master List prints the same words as the card image. The Master List repeats words published earlier; it is a version of its own because it was published after a different text (Bill, 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). As the latest publication it is the current text. The PC website card list was generated from the Holotable card data; the Master List went back to the release-sheet words. The Master List slip is the lower part of the card, as on the release sheet; it prints no slip number at bottom right (the release-sheet slip has “98”). GEMP's current card plays this text: STARTING deploys any [Immune to Alter] Effect (not only an always-immune one) and any number of <> sites (play change from the card-list text, approved by Bill, 11 November 2026).
